compare.description: Contrast two or more selected subjects and make their similarities and differences explicit.

connect.description: Traverse, sequence, or visualize verified relationships between selected subjects.

definitions.completion_policy: the request has a usable anchor or explicit Wiki scope and a provenance manifest
definitions.fallback_policy: ask one focused context question or stop with explicit insufficient evidence
definitions.risk_policy: read-only context selection; raw and secret content must stay outside prompts
definitions.title: 업무 맥락 Harness

definitions.completion_policy: every emitted factual claim is directly entailed by its bound internal chunks
definitions.fallback_policy: omit unsupported claims and return explicit insufficient or conflicting evidence
definitions.risk_policy: external knowledge is forbidden; definitions, conflicts, weak support and changing or executable outcomes use a fresh-context evaluator and fail closed
definitions.title: 내부 근거 Claim Harness

definitions.completion_policy: all Tasks have purpose, mode, completion checks, evidence and valid automatic bindings where needed
definitions.fallback_policy: save a private draft and interrupt for missing contracts
definitions.input_contract: SOP draft with Workflow and structured Task completion design
definitions.risk_policy: draft-only until a named person confirms the existing SOP publication path
definitions.title: SOP 작성 Harness

definitions.completion_policy: connector, schemas, risk and preview behavior are validated
definitions.fallback_policy: keep a Manual Action draft and interrupt for a missing connector or contract
definitions.output_contract: validated Action draft or dry-run result
definitions.risk_policy: new Action stays preview-only; side effects require Action Gateway policy and confirmation
definitions.title: Action 작성 Harness

definitions.completion_policy: an Action Gateway result is recorded and the Task completion binding verifies it
definitions.fallback_policy: policy stop or human interrupt; never choose another Action
definitions.risk_policy: dry-run first; medium/high risk or external side effects always require confirmation
definitions.title: Action 실행 Harness

definitions.completion_policy: sample decisions match the expected publish, ignore, suppress or pending result
definitions.fallback_policy: keep the draft inactive and interrupt for missing signal evidence
definitions.output_contract: SignalDecision preview and inactive definition draft
definitions.risk_policy: definitions remain inactive until sample test and explicit activation confirmation
definitions.title: 업무 이벤트 정의 Harness

definitions.completion_policy: the Skill contract and at least one representative test are valid
definitions.fallback_policy: keep the work Manual or Copilot and interrupt for a missing reusable contract
definitions.input_contract: Skill candidate with schemas, permissions and tests
definitions.risk_policy: Skill is a draft until tests pass; it cannot widen its own permissions
definitions.title: Skill 작성 Harness

definitions.completion_policy: ExitCriteriaResult and Evidence Ledger prove the Task is done
definitions.fallback_policy: strategy change once, then human interrupt or policy stop
definitions.risk_policy: Manual and Copilot need human confirmation; Autopilot needs allowlisted, verifiable system bindings
definitions.title: Task 수행 Harness

definitions.completion_policy: the candidate has provenance, reuse value and a passed promotion preview when shared
definitions.fallback_policy: keep or archive the private candidate; never auto-promote
definitions.output_contract: private provisional candidate or promotion preview
definitions.risk_policy: raw chat is never knowledge; Team/Public writes require promotion validation and explicit confirmation
definitions.title: 지식 자산화 Harness
